llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ni/Fe基高温合金的SLM工艺，与生物医学方向的应力屏蔽、多孔结构、疲劳或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stiffness matching, LPBF fabrication for biomedical implants, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对Ni/Fe超合金微观结构和物理性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备样品并进行微观组织表征和力学测试
summary_zh.result: 优化工艺参数可获得高致密度和良好力学性能的合金
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EBSD和力学实验验证微观结构和性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of Selective Laser Melting parameters on the microstructure and physical properties of a Ni/Fe-based superalloy.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM with varying parameters and characterized by SEM, EBSD, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Optimized processing parameters yield near-full density and improved mechanical strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis and mechanical tests confirmed the relationships between parameters and properties.

papers.title: The Relationship Between Agnostic Selective Classification Active Learning and the Disagreement Coefficient
papers.abstract: A selective classifier (f,g) comprises a classification function f and a binary selection function g, which determines if the classifier abstains from prediction, or uses f to predict. The classifier is called pointwise-competitive if it classifies each point identically to the best classifier in hindsight (from the same class), whenever it does not abstain. The quality of such a classifier is quantified by its rejection mass, defined to be the probability mass of the points it rejects. A "fast" rejection rate is achieved if the rejection mass is bounded from above by O(1/m) where m is the number of labeled examples used to train the classifier (and O hides logarithmic factors). Pointwise-competitive selective (PCS) classifiers are intimately related to disagreement-based active learning and it is known that in the realizable case, a fast rejection rate of a known PCS algorithm (called Consistent Selective Strategy) is equivalent to an exponential speedup of the well-known CAL active algorithm. We focus on the agnostic setting, for which there is a known algorithm called LESS that learns a PCS classifier and achieves a fast rejection rate (depending on Hanneke's disagreement coefficient) under strong assumptions. We present an improved PCS learning algorithm called ILESS for which we show a fast rate (depending on Hanneke's disagreement coefficient) without any assumptions. Our rejection bound smoothly interpolates the realizable and agnostic settings. The main result of this paper is an equivalence between the following three entities: (i) the existence of a fast rejection rate for any PCS learning algorithm (such as ILESS); (ii) a poly-logarithmic bound for Hanneke's disagreement coefficient; and (iii) an exponential speedup for a new disagreement-based active learner called ActiveiLESS.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究主动学习中的选择性分类与分歧系数，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。

summary_zh.motivation: 研究无假设下快速拒绝率的主动学习算法
summary_zh.method: 提出改进的PCS学习算法ILESS，证明其快速率与分歧系数等价
summary_zh.result: 建立了快速拒绝率、分歧系数和主动学习加速之间的等价关系

summary_en.motivation: To achieve fast rejection rates in agnostic selective classification without strong assumptions.
summary_en.method: Proposes an improved PCS learning algorithm ILESS and establishes equivalence between fast rejection rate, disagreement coefficient, and exponential speedup in active learning.
summary_en.result: The rejection bound smoothly interpolates realizable and agnostic settings, and the equivalence holds without assumptions.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proof only, no experimental validation.
